newsitem.title: USA: Cash Can approves share repurchase.
newsitem.headline: Cash Can approves share repurchase.

text.p: Cash Can Inc said it approved the purchase of up to one million of its shares over the next six months on the open market.

"We feel that the stock is extremely undervalued," Cash Can President and Chief Executive Officer Arthur Juhl said. "It makes sense for us to acquire the stock for future acquisitions and transactions."
"We are shooting for earnings of $0.06 per share for the first quarter of 1997, and progressively more with each quarter next year."
Comparative figures for the first quarter of last year were not immediately available.
